title: Regression tests: Codex stdin writer ends after server exit; delegation model refresh starts no owned server
outcome: Two behaviours added by the delegation-owned app-server change have no regression test: (1) the stdin writer and its watchdog end after the server exits while the input sender stays alive (ServerExited); (2) a delegation child with SessionRuntime::None refreshing its model list launches no owned server (live_server_count stays 0) and attaches no runtime.
acceptance: A behaviour test shows the Codex stdin writer and watchdog ending after the app-server exits while a sender stays alive.
A behaviour test shows a delegation child without a runtime refreshing its model list launches no owned server and attaches no runtime.
